attributions.author: Boris New, Christophe Pallier, Marc Brysbaert and Ludovic Ferrand
attributions.changes: Every form was written in the capitals A to Z — accents dropped, Œ and Æ spelled as two letters — and the ones holding a hyphen, an apostrophe or a space were left out, as were the ones shorter than two letters or longer than nine. The words a hidden word is drawn from are its nouns, adjectives and infinitives of five to eight letters, ranked by how often films say them, minus crude words and a few a reading judged unfit.
